reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000939 (the melody read from 000939a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Francois de La Feilee has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1808, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). John Bacchus Dykes's dates (1823–1876) are from our page for the tune DIES IRAE (DYKES) (content/hymns/tunes/dies-irae-dykes.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1868. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000939a.nwc).
